title: Technology viewer: Owned filter
description: A new last chip, Owned, in the technology filter row shows only the technologies the viewer already has. It combines with the colour chips and is exclusive with Can research now (an owned technology can never be researched). Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; the viewer owns Antimass Deflectors, Sarween Tools and Neural Motivator.

shots.heading: Before, desktop
shots.caption: The filter row ends with Can research now.

shots.heading: Owned on, desktop
shots.caption: Only the viewer's three technologies remain.

shots.heading: After, phone
shots.caption: Owned is the last chip in the scrolling row.

shots.heading: Owned on, phone
shots.caption: The pressed chip is scrolled into view; only owned technologies show.

notes.title: Exclusive with Can research now
notes.text: Pressing one turns the other off, since the two sets never overlap.

notes.title: Not persisted
notes.text: Like the other technology filters, the choice lives only while the dialog is open.

notes.title: Research dialogs
notes.text: Owned technologies are not offered there, so the filter shows an empty list with the usual no-match message.
